app.title: Corpus Agent
settings.chooseReference: Choose or drop a reference document
connectivity.title: View agent connectivity
connectivity.statusScope: Sources checked every 5 seconds while the diagram is open and visible: existence, type and operating-system access permissions. AI provider connectivity is checked without sending documents.
connectivity.description: Functional diagram of existing flows. Hover or focus the information buttons to inspect triggers.
connectivity.documentsTrigger: Analysis after importing a new or changed document, or deleting a document. Unchanged imports do not rerun analysis.
connectivity.folderTrigger: User-requested synchronization: new or changed files trigger analysis. External edits are not watched continuously.
connectivity.referenceTrigger: Analysis after import, replacement, deletion or an effective change to column mappings / header rows.
connectivity.baslTrigger: Analysis after import, replacement, deletion or an effective change to BASL column mappings / header rows.
connectivity.rulesTrigger: Saved rules apply on the next manual or source-triggered analysis. Saving rules alone does not rerun analysis.
connectivity.llm: AI checklist evaluation only when the LLM is enabled and configured.
connectivity.feedback: Business feedback loop: consult lessons, edit sources, then rerun analysis.
connectivity.limits: Periodic availability probes, not a file-change watcher. Access metadata does not validate document contents; /models does not test generation models. No source edits or model retraining.
app.titleTooltip: Drives content compliance across a document corpus using an AI-judged checklist of custom rules. The operator keeps full control over file edits, ensuring human review and business oversight.
llm.label: LLM
llm.title: AI status (see Settings)
errors.boundary.title: Something went wrong
errors.boundary.description: The interface ran into an error. You can reload the page to try again.
tickets.title: Tickets in scope
tickets.description: All projects by default, or only the selected projects. Tickets are grouped by file and collapsed by default.
tickets.empty: No tickets in this scope with these filters.
knowledge.learningScope: Capitalization of tickets marked fixed: recommendations are grouped without inventing rules. This does not retrain the AI model or prove automatic verification of corrections.
knowledge.capitalScope: Summary of all visible projects, independent of search.
knowledge.capitalPipeline: {{corrections}} corrections grouped into {{lessons}} recommendations across {{themes}} themes: a searchable foundation for future reviews.
knowledge.formalize: {{count}} correction(s) without recommendations still need to be formalized.
knowledge.growthScope: Reconstructed from resolution dates of tickets currently marked fixed, grouped by UTC day. Not an immutable history or a measure of reuse.
knowledge.undated: {{count}} correction(s) without usable dates, excluded from progression.
knowledge.noLesson: Correction recorded without a recommendation: a lesson still needs to be formalized.
knowledge.pending: {{count}} ticket(s) still open on this theme, not necessarily with the same cause.
